parts.text: Can I return the Solstice Edition trainers from order TF-88213? They arrived last week and are not faulty.
The product catalogue marks this edition final sale, so it cannot be returned even though it is within the general return window. Cite the product catalogue and do not claim a return was arranged.
The sole is separating on the trainers from order TF-88455. What does the exchange policy say I should do?
Explain the faulty-item replacement/refund policy and its customer next step, with a retrieved policy citation. Do not file a request, invent a REQ reference or claim an exchange is arranged.
